name: Vertex Coloring
problem_statement: Assign colors so vertices within a declared graph distance receive different colors.

normalization: Remove self-loops and collapse parallel edges to a simple graph.

solution_semantics.objective: Produce a proper coloring while heuristically limiting the number of colors.
solution_semantics.exactness: Coloring feasibility is exact; minimum chromatic number is not required.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Vertices separated by at most distance edges have distinct colors.
color_count equals the number of unique labels.
edge_cases: An empty graph uses zero colors.
An edgeless nonempty graph may use one color.

correctness: Vertices separated by at most distance edges have distinct colors.
color_count equals the number of unique labels.
